reapack.desc: Mirelo — AI sound effects & music for REAPER

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20 \b Mirelo for REAPER\b0\par \par Generate sound effects and music from a text prompt or the video on your timeline, and extend or inpaint audio clips - all inside REAPER, powered by Mirelo (https://mirelo.ai).\par \par Requires ReaImGui >= 0.9 (install via ReaPack) and curl >= 7.73 (in-box on modern OSes). SWS is optional for in-panel preview.\par}

version.author: Mirelo
version.changelog: - Sound effects from a prompt or from your video now use Mirelo's new SFX 2.0 model, and a selection can run up to ten minutes. Extend, inpaint and loop keep using the current model. - Sound from video leaves the dialogue in your clip out of the generated audio, so it doesn't play twice beside your original track. - Sound from video and video-guided extend now work on macOS. They used to stop with a render error. - A prompt longer than the model accepts is flagged before you generate, instead of being refused afterwards. - Long selections no longer time out while uploading, generating or downloading on a slower connection. - The window no longer closes with an error when your results don't fit in it. - When you run short of credits, the panel shows what the generation needs and a button to fix it, and the estimate no longer rounds up by a credit.
